component.name: WirelessDisplay
component.summary: Share your screen with Wi-Fi displays

description.p: Experimental Linux desktop application for video-only Miracast streaming over Wi-Fi Direct, using XDG Desktop Portal, PipeWire and GStreamer.

Negotiates Wi-Fi Display over RTSP and transmits H.264 in MPEG-TS/RTP. Television interoperability remains experimental. Audio, HDCP and UIBC are not enabled. A dummy mode supports development without wireless display hardware.
